Perfect! All prices now work correctly. The issue was floating-point precision when converting to cents—39.95 * 100 would produce 3995.0000000000005 instead of 3995. Using `Math.round()` ensures we get the exact integer value.

Fix floating-point precision in price conversion to cents

floating-point arithmetic errors like 39.95 * 100 = 3995.0000000000005.
Fixes prices like 39.95, 19.95, and other decimal values that hit the
precision edge case.
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
